aiActionsLog.summary: Established Architecture Intelligence System (AIS) unified CombineNet compiler integrations.
aiActionsLog.reason: Eliminate scattered JSON artifacts to align metrics under a single versioned contract.
aiActionsLog.impact: Enables stable dashboard loads on direct filesystem runs and local server environments.

aiActionsLog.summary: Corrected canvas re-render crashes with .destroy() context verification.
aiActionsLog.reason: Canvas container elements throws unexpected DOM exception on active view redraw cycles.
aiActionsLog.impact: Guarantees fluid 60fps renders on mobile and large touch screen displays.

aiActionsLog.summary: Configured absolute state URL resolver based on window.location inspect parameters.
aiActionsLog.reason: GitHub Pages and localhost run under variable subdirectory rules leading to nested 404 fetch exceptions.
aiActionsLog.impact: Averts broken fallback loaders, routing absolute state fetches deterministically.

aiActionsLog.summary: Created the Wear Core Intelligence Archive System including global file inventory, file history tracker, AI actions registry, and dual exports.
aiActionsLog.reason: Transform Wear Core into an autonomous, self-documenting digital system fully queryable and readable by human and machine intellects.
aiActionsLog.impact: Unlocks remote AI diagnostics by exposing full state schemas and project memories through easy-to-fetch URL pages.
